legal.agreement: By clicking continue, you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

testimonial.quote: Ringee.io has drastically reduced our communication costs while delivering outstanding call quality. It's a game-changer for any business that values both efficiency and affordability.
testimonial.author: Grupo Betuel

signIn.title: Sign in to Ringee
signIn.description: Welcome back. Enter your credentials to continue.

signUp.title: Create your Ringee account
signUp.description: Start making global calls in minutes.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: We'll email you a link to reset it.

phoneVerification.title: Verify your phone number
phoneVerification.phoneDescription: We'll send you a one-time code to confirm this number belongs to you.
phoneVerification.smsHint: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS.
phoneVerification.securityNote: Your number is protected by Clerk and is never shared publicly.
phoneVerification.invalidPhone: Enter a valid phone number, including the country code.
phoneVerification.sendCodeError: We couldn't send the verification code. Please try again.
phoneVerification.codeDescription: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {phone}.
phoneVerification.verifyCodeError: That code couldn't be verified. Check it and try again.
phoneVerification.codeResent: We sent you a new verification code.
phoneVerification.noSmsDescription: Support can review your case if SMS delivery isn't available in your country.
phoneVerification.accessStillRequired: Approval is still pending. We'll keep checking automatically.
phoneVerification.checkError: We couldn't check your approval status. Please try again.

errors.accountLocked: Your account has been locked. Contact support.
errors.emailInUse: An account with this email already exists.
errors.weakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters.

cliAuthorize.title: Authorize Ringee CLI
cliAuthorize.subtitle: A terminal is asking to use your Ringee account.

enterCode.title: Connect a terminal
enterCode.description: Enter the code your terminal shows after running ringee login.
enterCode.label: One-time code

cliAuthorize.codeLabel: Check that this code matches your terminal
cliAuthorize.workspaceHint: You can switch any time with ringee workspace use.
cliAuthorize.access: The terminal will act as you in Ringee — contacts, calls, campaigns, callbacks and AI voice agents — until you revoke it in Settings → Connectors.
cliAuthorize.phishingWarning: Only authorize if you just ran ringee login yourself. Never approve a code someone sent you.

approved.title: Terminal authorized
approved.description: Go back to your terminal — you're logged in. You can close this tab.

denied.title: Access denied
denied.description: The terminal was not given access to your account. You can close this tab.

expired.title: This code expired
expired.description: Codes last 10 minutes. Run ringee login again to get a new one.

used.title: This code was already used
used.description: Each code works once. Run ringee login again to connect another terminal.

notFound.title: Code not found
notFound.description: Check the code in your terminal, or run ringee login again.

cliAuthorize.loadError: We couldn't load this login request. Refresh to try again.
